description: This file defines an abstract class 'Connection' responsible for managing network connections within the Orleans runtime. It handles connection lifecycle, message processing (incoming and outgoing), error handling, and logging. The class interacts with network transport, message serialization, and connection features, providing a foundation for specific connection implementations.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: An abstract class managing network connection lifecycle, message processing, and error handling within Orleans. It provides hooks for subclasses to implement specific transport and message handling logic.

classes.name: MessageHandlerPoolPolicy
classes.description: A pooled object policy for creating and resetting MessageHandler instances used in message processing.

classes.name: MessageHandler
classes.description: A work item that processes a received message by invoking the connection's message handling method, used in thread pool processing.

classes.name: EndPointLogValue
classes.description: A struct for logging endpoint information in a consistent format.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts processing the connection, including executing the middleware and handling connection closure.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues a message for sending over the connection.

methods.name: ProcessIncoming
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and processes incoming messages from the network stream.

methods.name: ProcessOutgoing
methods.description: Asynchronously sends queued messages over the network stream.

methods.name: StartClosing
methods.description: Begins the process of closing the connection, handling cleanup and rerouting messages.

methods.name: OnTransportConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when the underlying transport connection is closed.

methods.name: HandleReceiveMessageFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during message reception, including logging and error propagation.

methods.name: HandleSendMessageFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during message sending, including retries and error reporting.
